author: Yffe
content: Failing test at thermite-skill/tests/divergence_unit_arm_example.rs::rendered_fn_examples_parse_clean (run with --ignored) demonstrates the divergence. render_type_arm's Type::Unit arm in generate.rs renders the example `fn log() -> () ens true fx pure { }` which OMITS the mandatory req clause; thermite_syntax::parser::parse rejects it with 'clause `req` is out of order'. The same fn WITH `req true` parses clean. The skill's own render_grammar prose states 'absence of any is a parse error'. Authority: thermite-design.md §10 (skill IS the spec, no version skew); skill-generator.md REQ-10/REQ-8. R-CHAR-3: expected value = parser-accepts, not copied from generate.rs.
